elements.requirement: Section 2 applies where lands of different owners adjoin and, at the line of junction, the lands are built on or a boundary wall (being a party fence wall or the external wall of a building) has been erected.
elements.quote: This section applies where lands of different owners adjoin and at the line of junction the said lands are built on or a boundary wall, being a party fence wall or the external wall of a building, has been erected

elements.requirement: A building owner has the right to underpin, thicken, or raise a party structure, a party fence wall, or an external wall belonging to the building owner that is built against a party structure or party fence wall.
elements.quote: to underpin, thicken or raise a party structure, a party fence wall, or an external wall which belongs to the building owner and is built against a party structure or party fence wall

elements.requirement: A building owner has the right to make good, repair, or demolish and rebuild a party structure or party fence wall when necessary due to defect or want of repair of the structure or wall.
elements.quote: to make good, repair, or demolish and rebuild, a party structure or party fence wall in a case where such work is necessary on account of defect or want of repair of the structure or wall

elements.requirement: A building owner has the right to demolish a partition separating buildings belonging to different owners that does not conform with statutory requirements and build a conforming party wall instead.
elements.quote: to demolish a partition which separates buildings belonging to different owners but does not conform with statutory requirements and to build instead a party wall which does so conform

elements.requirement: In the case of buildings connected by arches or structures over public ways or passages belonging to other persons, a building owner has the right to demolish and rebuild non-conforming parts or wholes so that they conform with statutory requirements.
elements.quote: in the case of buildings connected by arches or structures over public ways or over passages belonging to other persons, to demolish the whole or part of such buildings, arches or structures which do not conform with statutory requirements and to rebuild them so that they do so conform

elements.requirement: A building owner has the right to demolish a party structure of insufficient strength or height for an intended building and rebuild it of sufficient strength or height, including rebuilding to a lesser height or thickness if sufficient for the adjoining owner.
elements.quote: to demolish a party structure which is of insufficient strength or height for the purposes of any intended building of the building owner and to rebuild it of sufficient strength or height for the said purposes (including rebuilding to a lesser height or thickness where the rebuilt structure is of sufficient strength and height for the purposes of any adjoining owner)

elements.requirement: A building owner has the right to cut into a party structure for any purpose, including the insertion of a damp proof course.
elements.quote: to cut into a party structure for any purpose (which may be or include the purpose of inserting a damp proof course)

elements.requirement: A building owner has the right to cut away any footing, projecting chimney breast, jamb, flue, or other projection on or over the building owner's land from a party wall, party fence wall, external wall, or boundary wall to erect, raise, or underpin such wall, or for any other purpose.
elements.quote: to cut away from a party wall, party fence wall, external wall or boundary wall any footing or any projecting chimney breast, jamb or flue, or other projection on or over the land of the building owner in order to erect, raise or underpin any such wall or for any other purpose

elements.requirement: A building owner has the right to cut away or demolish overhanging parts of an adjoining owner's wall or building to the extent necessary to erect or raise a vertical wall against it.
elements.quote: to cut away or demolish parts of any wall or building of an adjoining owner overhanging the land of the building owner or overhanging a party wall, to the extent that it is necessary to cut away or demolish the parts to enable a vertical wall to be erected or raised against the wall or building of the adjoining owner

elements.requirement: A building owner has the right to cut into the wall of an adjoining owner's building to insert flashing or other weather-proofing for a wall erected against that wall.
elements.quote: to cut into the wall of an adjoining owner’s building in order to insert a flashing or other weather-proofing of a wall erected against that wall

elements.requirement: A building owner has the right to execute any other necessary works incidental to connecting a party structure with adjoining premises.
elements.quote: to execute any other necessary works incidental to the connection of a party structure with the premises adjoining it

elements.requirement: A building owner has the right to raise a party fence wall, raise it for use as a party wall, or demolish and rebuild it as a party fence wall or party wall.
elements.quote: to raise a party fence wall, or to raise such a wall for use as a party wall, and to demolish a party fence wall and rebuild it as a party fence wall or as a party wall

elements.requirement: Subject to section 11(7), a building owner has the right to reduce, or demolish and rebuild, a party wall or party fence wall to a height of not less than two metres where not used by an adjoining owner to any greater extent than a boundary wall, or to a height currently enclosed upon by an adjoining owner's building.
elements.quote: subject to the provisions of section 11(7), to reduce, or to demolish and rebuild, a party wall or party fence wall to— (i) a height of not less than two metres where the wall is not used by an adjoining owner to any greater extent than a boundary wall; or (ii) a height currently enclosed upon by the building of an adjoining owner

elements.requirement: A building owner has the right to expose a previously enclosed party wall or party structure subject to providing adequate weathering.
elements.quote: to expose a party wall or party structure hitherto enclosed subject to providing adequate weathering

elements.requirement: Where underpinning, thickening, or raising under section 2(2)(a) is not necessary on account of defect or want of repair, the building owner must make good all damage caused to adjoining premises or their internal furnishings and decorations.
elements.quote: subject to making good all damage occasioned by the work to the adjoining premises or to their internal furnishings and decorations

elements.requirement: Where underpinning, thickening, or raising under section 2(2)(a) is carried out on a party structure or external wall and is not necessary on account of defect or want of repair, the building owner must carry up any adjoining owner's flues and chimney stacks that form part of or rest on or against the structure or wall to an agreed height and material, or as determined under section 10.
elements.quote: where the work is to a party structure or external wall, subject to carrying any relevant flues and chimney stacks up to such a height and in such materials as may be agreed between the building owner and the adjoining owner concerned or, in the event of dispute, determined in accordance with section 10

elements.requirement: A building owner exercising the right under section 2(2)(e) must make good all damage caused to adjoining premises or their internal furnishings and decorations, and carry up any adjoining owner's relevant flues and chimney stacks to an agreed height and material, or as determined under section 10.
elements.quote: The right falling within subsection (2)(e) is exercisable subject to— (a) making good all damage occasioned by the work to the adjoining premises or to their internal furnishings and decorations; and (b) carrying any relevant flues and chimney stacks up to such a height and in such materials as may be agreed between the building owner and the adjoining owner concerned or, in the event of dispute, determined in accordance with section 10

elements.requirement: A building owner exercising any right under section 2(2)(f), (g), or (h) must make good all damage caused to adjoining premises or their internal furnishings and decorations.
elements.quote: Any right falling within subsection (2)(f), (g) or (h) is exercisable subject to making good all damage occasioned by the work to the adjoining premises or to their internal furnishings and decorations

elements.requirement: A building owner exercising the right under section 2(2)(j) must make good all damage caused to the wall of the adjoining owner’s building.
elements.quote: The right falling within subsection (2)(j) is exercisable subject to making good all damage occasioned by the work to the wall of the adjoining owner’s building

elements.requirement: A building owner exercising the right under section 2(2)(m) must reconstruct any parapet, replace an existing parapet, or construct a parapet where one is needed but did not previously exist.
elements.quote: The right falling within subsection (2)(m) is exercisable subject to— (a) reconstructing any parapet or replacing an existing parapet with another one; or (b) constructing a parapet where one is needed but did not exist before

elements.requirement: A building or structure erected before the passage of the Act is deemed to conform with statutory requirements if it conformed with the statutes regulating buildings or structures on the date of its erection.
elements.quote: a building or structure which was erected before the day on which this Act was passed shall be deemed to conform with statutory requirements if it conforms with the statutes regulating buildings or structures on the date on which it was erected

thresholds.what: minimum height for reducing or rebuilding a party wall or party fence wall not used by an adjoining owner to any greater extent than a boundary wall
thresholds.quote: a height of not less than two metres

thresholds.what: temporal cutoff for deeming a building or structure to conform with statutory requirements
thresholds.value: the day on which this Act was passed
thresholds.quote: before the day on which this Act was passed
